verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that TaxJar AutoFile files returns and remits payments on time. Nothing in the pack documents an ops-facing view of that work: no calendar of upcoming returns, no per-filing status, no remitted-amount reporting, and no downloadable filing confirmations. Filing automation and a historical data archive are related features and do not deliver this visibility story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see the whole filing picture — a calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status, the amounts remitted, and downloadable confirmations for every return submitted
